_note: Bellingham, WA grocery stores and their standing deal programs. Researched 2026-11-04 from store sites and locator pages. Closed stores (Cost Cutter, Terra Organica) are omitted. Dated rows carry validFrom/validTo and age out automatically.

stores.description: Albertsons-owned regional grocer; Haggen for U loyalty and digital coupons.

stores.name: Haggen Food & Pharmacy - Barkley
stores.description: Open 5am-midnight daily. Haggen for U app and digital coupons.

stores.name: Haggen Food & Pharmacy - Sehome
stores.description: Sehome Village Haggen.

stores.name: Fred Meyer - Bakerview

stores.name: Fred Meyer - Lakeway
stores.description: Second Bellingham Fred Meyer; open until 11pm.

stores.name: Safeway - Sunset Square
stores.description: Bellingham's only Safeway (former Cost Cutter space). Open 5am-midnight.

stores.name: WinCo Foods
stores.address: 300 E Bellis Fair Pkwy, Bellingham, WA 98226
stores.description: Employee-owned, everyday-low-price warehouse grocer with big bulk bins. No loyalty card; debit/cash/EBT only.

stores.name: Trader Joe's - James Street
stores.description: No weekly ad or coupons; everyday pricing only.

stores.name: Trader Joe's - Meridian
stores.description: Opened May 2025 in Cordata Center; open 8am-9pm daily.

stores.name: Whole Foods Market - Lakeway
stores.description: Open 8am-9pm daily. Prime member deals plus an extra 10% off sale items.

stores.name: Community Food Co-op - Downtown
stores.description: Open 7am-9pm. Anyone can shop; membership is a one-time $90 equity share.

stores.name: Community Food Co-op - Cordata
stores.description: Open 7am-9pm. Same deal programs as the Downtown store.

stores.name: Grocery Outlet Bargain Market
stores.description: Closeout grocer; 'WOW' tags mark 50-70% off conventional retail.

stores.name: Costco Wholesale
stores.description: Membership required. Mon-Fri 10am-8:30pm, Sat 9:30am-7pm, Sun 10am-6pm.

stores.name: Walmart Supercenter
stores.description: Rollbacks only; no day-specific deal program.

stores.name: Target - Bellis Fair
stores.description: Limited grocery; Target Circle deals and a Sun-Sat weekly ad.

stores.name: Bellingham Farmers Market
stores.description: Saturdays 10am-2pm at Depot Market Square, April through Dec 19. Off-season: 3rd Saturday of Jan/Feb/Mar.

stores.name: La Gloria Market
stores.description: Latin American grocery, carniceria and taqueria (may now operate as Patrones Market).

stores.name: Asia Oriental Market
stores.description: Small family-owned East Asian grocery.

deals.title: $5 Friday
deals.description: Rotating selection of items (produce, meat, bakery, prepared foods) priced at $5 every Friday; announced Wednesday for the coming Friday. Safeway for U member price.

deals.title: Safeway for U digital coupons
deals.description: Free loyalty program with clippable digital coupons, personalized deals and points. Weekly ad runs Wed-Tue.

deals.title: Haggen for U digital coupons & points
deals.description: Free app/loyalty program with clippable digital coupons and points redeemable for cash off groceries or gas. Applies at all four Bellingham Haggen stores.

deals.title: Weekly Ad (Wed-Tue)
deals.description: New weekly ad every Wednesday; clip digital coupons in the Haggen for U app before checkout.

deals.title: Weekly Ad (Wed-Tue)
deals.description: New weekly ad every Wednesday; clip digital coupons in the Haggen for U app before checkout.

deals.title: Weekly Ad (Wed-Tue)
deals.description: New weekly ad every Wednesday; clip digital coupons in the Haggen for U app before checkout.

deals.title: Senior Discount Day (first Tuesday)
deals.description: 10% off select items for shoppers 55+ on the first Tuesday of every month; excludes alcohol, tobacco, candy and by-the-pound departments. Also at Lakeway.

deals.title: Fuel Points
deals.description: Earn 1 Fuel Point per $1 spent (bonus on gift cards); redeem for up to $1 off per gallon at Fred Meyer Fuel Centers. Applies at both Bellingham stores.

deals.title: Weekly Digital Deals
deals.description: Digital-coupon-only prices that change weekly (ad week Wed-Tue); each digital deal can be used up to 5 times in one transaction. Short weekend digital offers drop most Fridays.

deals.title: Everyday low prices & bulk bins
deals.description: No membership or loyalty card; large bulk-bin section (buy any quantity); yellow-tag 'Hot Buys' markdowns. Debit, cash, check and EBT only.

deals.title: Fresh Deals (new every Wednesday)
deals.description: Produce, meat/seafood and cheese specials chosen each Wednesday, open to everyone. Nov 4-10: Organic Hass Avocado 2/$5, Organic Honeycrisp Apples $2.49/lb, Co-op Breakfast Sausage $5.99/lb, Appel Farms Feta $6.29/7oz. Also at Cordata.

deals.title: Fresh Deals (new every Wednesday)
deals.description: Produce, meat/seafood and cheese specials chosen each Wednesday, open to everyone. Same picks as Downtown.

deals.title: Co+op Deals (biweekly flyer)
deals.description: Two-week sale flyer on hundreds of natural/organic products; separate flyers for Downtown and Cordata. Open to all shoppers.

deals.title: Co-op Basics (purple shelf tags)
deals.description: Ongoing everyday-low prices on staple groceries and household items, marked with purple shelf tags at both stores.

deals.title: Member Appreciation: 10% off one shop
deals.description: Members get 10% off one in-store shop (single use), at Downtown and Cordata. 2026 windows: Feb 1-15, Jul 1-15, Oct 1-15, Nov 1-15.

deals.title: Member Appreciation: 10% off one shop
deals.description: Members get 10% off one in-store shop (single use). Nov 1-15, 2026.

deals.title: Member case discount
deals.description: Members save 15% on case orders year-round; patronage dividend in profitable years.

deals.title: WOW deals & Weekly Wins
deals.description: In-store 'WOW' tags mark items 50-70% off conventional retail; opt-in WOW Alert emails push top unadvertised deals. Weekly Wins circular resets Wednesday.

deals.title: Prime member deals
deals.description: Amazon Prime members get 30+ exclusive weekly deals plus an additional 10% off sale items (excludes alcohol); sales flyer rotates Wednesday.

deals.title: Member-Only Warehouse Savings (monthly booklet)
deals.description: Roughly monthly coupon booklet with instant savings (per-member limits). Current book valid Oct 19 - Nov 15, 2026.

deals.title: Saturday Market
deals.description: Weekly market with local produce, meat, bread, cheese and prepared food. SNAP Market Match tokens at the Info Booth (confirm the 2026 cap). Runs through Dec 19.

deals.title: Target Circle deals & weekly ad
deals.description: Free Target Circle loyalty program with a rotating weekly ad (Sun-Sat) and Circle offers.
